neighbours.label: text about Finland: Finnish places, companies and customs (Helsinki, Espoo, Lapland, sauna, the Finns), firing on the words just after the Finnish mention; Sweden, Norway and the Baltics in the same frames stay low
fire: Our train pulled into Tampere just after the lakes had frozen.
Every summer cottage on the Finnish coast has a wood-fired sauna by the shore.
The engineers who wrote Linux grew up in Helsinki and studied there.
Herders in Finnish Lapland gather their reindeer before the first snow.
A small studio in Espoo released the mobile game that topped every chart.
Voters in Finland chose a new president after a long winter campaign.
Tourists in Rovaniemi queue to meet Santa Claus every December.
The Finns drink more coffee per person than almost anyone else.
quiet: Our train pulled into Uppsala just after the lakes had frozen.
Every summer cottage on the Swedish coast has a red wooden boathouse by the shore.
The engineers who wrote the browser grew up in Oslo and studied there.
Herders in northern Norway gather their reindeer before the first snow.
A small studio in Stockholm released the mobile game that topped every chart.
Voters in Latvia chose a new president after a long winter campaign.
Tourists in Copenhagen queue to see the changing of the guard every December.
The Swedes drink more coffee per person than almost anyone else.
